model.description: The {@link ReliabilityMlModel} whose {@link ReliabilityMlDatasetPreparationRun} contains the mask to be queried.

maskName.description:
The name of the mask to extract from the [dataset preparation run](ReliabilityMlDatasetPreparationRun).

@see ReliabilityMlDatasetPreparationRunCommon#maskDatasets

label.description: The label to show for the break time ranges. This can be a translation key.

title:
Query for extracting a specific mask from {@link ReliabilityMlDatasetPreparationRunCommon#maskDatasets} given a
{@link ReliabilityMlModel}.

This timed data query retrieves the mask values (capsule) associated with the provided model and mask name,
and builds a time range representing periods to be excluded from analysis (e.g., non-operational periods).

Used to support charting and analytics that require masking out certain time intervals.
name: ReliabilityCapsuleTimedDataQuery
